entries.title: Banished

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with mod support.

primary.why: Banished is a Windows PC release, and PC is the only sourced release route. It also provides the game's mod support and the cleanest capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Play Banished on Windows PC through Steam or GOG; use the native PC version and add mods only after learning the vanilla survival-city loop.

entries.remaster_caveats: Banished has no separate remaster or sequel entry in the current sourced release set.
